_doc: Graphics options (game/settings/*.gd). default: the preset of a new install; auto starts at the tier the GPU's name gives (gpu_rules, first match; regular expressions on RenderingServer.get_video_adapter_name, unknown = gpu_default) and the governor moves it, never above that tier. levels: the tiers, weakest first. Each tier: pixel_ratio the most device pixels per CSS pixel drawn (the 3D scale is min(1, pixel_ratio / screen ratio)); shadows and shadow_px the side of a cascade (4 splits share an atlas of twice that side, Godot docs: Lights and shadows); shadow_distance_m the sun's reach; msaa 0, 1, 2 = off, 2x, 4x (Viewport.msaa_3d); smaa the post filter (Viewport.screen_space_aa); ssao and ssao_half the ambient occlusion and its half resolution (RenderingServer.environment_set_ssao_quality); anisotropy 0..4 = off..16x (Viewport.anisotropic_filtering_level); detail_props the street furniture layer; triangle_share the buildings' near level as a share of its triangles: its reach scales by the square root (triangles grow with the area in reach). frame_cap: Engine.max_fps while the game has the focus (the player's choice, fps_choices, 0 = none) and while another application has it; a covered window is not held back by vsync. governor: a window of window frames (a p90 over 1,5 s at 60 Hz, ARQUITETURA.md item 8), settle frames left out after a change, down after down_windows missed, up after up_windows under up_share of the budget, a raise undone within undone_s holds hold_s (doubled each time), a frame over stall_s is a stall. ssao: RenderingServer.environment_set_ssao_quality's arguments at the Godot project setting defaults (rendering/environment/ssao/*). dynamic_resolution: scales of the 3D drawing, whole first, aim share of the budget, window frames a decision, deadband and rise_margin keep the picture from breathing, settle frames left out after a change. post: bloom, ambient occlusion and SMAA at all (the post chain). vegetation: share of the woods and lone trees (street and park trees stay). detail_cutoff_zoom: pixels per metre below which furniture, vehicles, people and road paint stop being drawn. pedestrian_detail: 0 the far level only. occupant_zoom: pixels per metre at which the cabin level ends; vehicle_error_px divides that reach (a fixed shape's error on the screen falls with the distance), vehicle_whole_cap: the most cabins drawn, the nearest. sky_clouds and cloud_shadows: for the sky's owner to read from Settings.current() on `changed`. layers: what shows over the map when nothing was chosen. presets: what the player can choose and what a settings file may hold; anything else falls to default.
